note: Hand-authored task substrate; not generated. This file DECLARES who owns the graded evaluation split and which records are withheld from the training feed. It carries none of the graded split's bytes, and the previous revision's inlined held-out token payload is gone from the agent-visible surface with it.

graded_evaluation_split.collection: FineWeb10B validation shards, GPT-2 BPE token ids, uint16 little-endian
graded_evaluation_split.why_absent: The number that scores a submission is computed by the verifier on a held-out split the solver cannot see, from the parameter snapshots the frozen trainer wrote. A split shipped inside environment/ is a split the solver can fit, so these bytes live with the verifier and nowhere else. environment/train_frozen.py refuses to start if a shard matching this glob is reachable from the container it runs in.
graded_evaluation_split.split_id_binding: the split id in force is read from the harness at run time, never hardcoded here. A verdict computed against an id the harness has rotated away from is a stale verdict.

held_out_records_are_not_the_graded_spli: The three keys below are the leakage-control declaration over the record corpus at environment/corpus/. They name the records that must not reach the training feed under any parse outcome and under any ambiguity policy. They are NOT the graded evaluation split, they carry no evaluation payload, and the loss that scores a submission is never computed on them.
split_id_note: This is the declaration's own last-known id. The id in force at grading time is the one the harness binds, and the pipeline reads it from the harness rather than from this file.
